title: Continuing the UI polish after a restart

steps.text: Picking this back up. The helper and its tests are still in the checkout, and the spacing rule I was waiting on you for never got answered - so I am asking again rather than guessing at it. There are also three messages of yours queued behind this; I will take them in order once this is unblocked.

questions.question: How should the header space its chips?

options.label: One 6px gap on the row
options.description: the row owns the spacing and every chip drops its own margins - consistent, and it re-flows correctly when a chip is absent

options.label: Keep per-chip margins
options.description: a smaller diff today, but the row still reads unevenly the moment a chip is conditional

questions.question: What should a glyph-only chip do about its accessible name?

options.label: Keep the glyph and add a label
options.description: the glyph stays decorative and the control carries a real name - two characters wider, readable by everything

options.label: Glyph with a tooltip only
options.description: narrowest, but the accessible name is then whatever the tooltip happens to say

steps.text: Thanks. Moving the spacing onto the row and giving the glyph chips real labels.

input.description: one gap on the header row, and drop the per-chip margins

steps.text: Header is even at every width now, and the glyph chips read as controls rather than as decoration. Your queued notes are next.
